units.title: Consistent aggregation of judgments on logically connected propositions

required_components.description: Define the proposition agenda, complete judgment sets and aggregation function.
required_components.success_condition: State exactly which negations/conjunctions are included and distinguish assent from lack of assent.
required_components.failure_condition: Read nonacceptance as denial without the completeness condition.

required_components.description: Prove the identified impossibility theorem with all output and input conditions.
required_components.success_condition: Retain universal domain, anonymity, systematicity, completeness, the source's consistency definition and deductive closure.
required_components.failure_condition: Substitute Arrow's theorem or silently drop a stated condition.

required_components.description: Work the doctrinal-paradox profile and distinguish conclusion-based from premise-based procedures.
required_components.success_condition: Display each person's coherent set and calculate the collective outcome for each specified procedure.
required_components.failure_condition: Infer that individual consistency guarantees proposition-wise majority consistency.

required_components.description: Compare the source's escape routes by which condition they alter.
required_components.success_condition: Show one consistent procedure and explicitly name the original axiom it relaxes.
required_components.failure_condition: Announce a universal solution satisfying every incompatible requirement.
